content_sections.heading: SNS Bank Vijayapura Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Sarkari Naukarara Sahakari Bank Niyamita, Vijayapura has officially released the recruitment notification dated 05 September 2026 for Junior Assistant and Sepoy/ Watchman posts. A total of 18 vacancies have been announced, including 12 Junior Assistant and 6 Sepoy/ Watchman posts. The notification includes complete details on vacancies, eligibility criteria, educational qualifications, age limits, application fee, salary, selection process, required documents and online application procedure. Candidates are strongly advised to read the full notification carefully before applying. The notification is available on the official SNS Bank Vijayapura website. content_sections.heading: SNS Bank Vijayapura Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: SNS Bank Vijayapura Recruitment 2026 has been released for a total of 18 vacancies across two posts, as classified by the government order. The notification states that the state government will provide dearness allowance (DA) and other allowances to bank employees as revised from time to time.

content_sections.heading: SNS Bank Vijayapura Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfil the SNS Bank Vijayapura eligibility criteria on the last date fixed for submission of applications, for the respective post applied for. A degree in any discipline from a university established by law in India, with a minimum aggregate of 60% marks. Ability to read Kannada, along with knowledge of Kannada, writing skill, and the ability to speak and understand Kannada fluently. Knowledge of computer operations and applications. SSLC (10th standard) pass with a minimum aggregate of 50% marks. Must have studied Kannada as one language. Note: The notification specifically requires these qualifications; candidates not meeting the exact percentage and language conditions are not eligible, even if they hold an equivalent qualification.

content_sections.heading: SNS Bank Vijayapura Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: The SNS Bank Vijayapura age limit is calculated as on the last date fixed for submission of the online application. The minimum age is 18 years for both posts. The maximum age limit, as per Karnataka Government rules, is given below. As per Karnataka Government Order No. ಸಿಆಸುಇ262ಸೇನೇ2025, Bangalore, dated 29-01-2026, an additional age relaxation of 5 years is applicable over the maximum age limit shown above. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: SNS Bank Vijayapura Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the Junior Assistant post is through a written examination followed by an interview. A merit list is prepared based on marks scored in the written examination, and candidates are called for interview in a ratio of 1:5. Marks fixed for the interview: 15. The written examination marks are converted to 85% weightage and added to the interview marks to prepare the final merit list, from which selection is made as per rules. The written examination for Junior Assistant carries 100 marks each in two question papers (200 marks total): Selection for the Sepoy/ Watchman (Group D) post is based on a written examination. Candidates are called for interview in a ratio of 1:5 based on the percentage of marks obtained in the written exam. Interview marks are limited to 15% weightage of the qualifying marks obtained in the written exam.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for SNS Bank Vijayapura Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must scan and upload the following documents along with the online application: Passport size photograph SSLC marks card / transfer certificate, for age verification Qualification certificate For SC/ ST, Category-1, backward class and other candidates seeking reservation benefits: caste certificate obtained from the concerned authority, in the government-prescribed format For Category 2(A) and 2(B) candidates: a recent income and caste certificate in Form F from the concerned Tahsildar; the original certificate must be submitted to the bank at the time of document verification

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SNS Bank Vijayapura Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply for SNS Bank Vijayapura Recruitment 2026 only through the online application link on the bank's official website. Visit the official website: https:/ / snsbankvijayapur.com/ Open the online application link provided on the website. Select the desired post (Junior Assistant or Sepoy/ Watchman) and fill in the application form completely. Upload the required documents listed above, in scanned format. Pay the applicable application fee for the selected post and category. Submit the application before 28/ 09/ 2026, 5:30 PM. Important conditions for applying: Applications can be submitted only online; applications sent by post, courier, email, in person or through any other mode will not be accepted. All fields in the application form must be filled completely. Knowledge of Kannada is mandatory for all candidates. Incomplete applications, or applications without the required documents uploaded, or applications submitted after the last date, will be rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is SNS Bank Vijayapura Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an official recruitment drive by Sarkari Naukarara Sahakari Bank Niyamita, Vijayapura, to fill 18 vacancies for Junior Assistant and Sepoy/Watchman posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in SNS Bank Vijayapura Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 18 vacancies in total: 12 for Junior Assistant and 6 for Sepoy/Watchman.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for SNS Bank Vijayapura Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 28-09-2026, up to 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for SNS Bank Vijayapura Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Junior Assistant requires any degree with a minimum of 60% marks along with Kannada language proficiency and computer knowledge. Sepoy/Watchman requires SSLC pass with a minimum of 50% marks and Kannada as one language of study.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for SNS Bank Vijayapura Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years. The maximum age is 35 years for general category, 38 years for Category 2(A)/2(B)/3(B), and 40 years for SC/ST and Category-1 candidates, with an additional 5-year relaxation as per the Karnataka Government order dated 29-01-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for SNS Bank Vijayapura Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For Junior Assistant, the fee is ₹1,200 for general/other candidates and ₹600 for SC/ST candidates. For Sepoy/Watchman, the fee is ₹600 for general/other candidates and ₹400 for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for SNS Bank Vijayapura Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply only through the official website, https://snsbankvijayapur.com/, by filling the application form completely and uploading the required documents before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for SNS Bank Vijayapura Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Junior Assistant selection is through a written exam (200 marks across two papers) followed by an interview (15 marks), with the final merit list based on 85% weightage of written exam marks combined with interview marks. Sepoy/Watchman selection is through a written exam followed by an interview limited to 15% weightage.
